I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team: the store is Pine Crossing.

That comes from her own post in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026. She wrote that the Pine Crossing morning receiver saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver had arrived at 7:10 and they wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce it with the store login.

I couldn't find anything in the channel or the shared files saying it was fixed, so I told her to check before she marks it resolved on the account sheet. I only used #central-team and public files, which she can see herself.
